name: Watten
description: Watten is an Alpine trick-taking game from Bavaria/Tyrol. 4 players in 2 teams. 32-card German deck. 5 cards each. Features trump SUIT + trump RANK (Schlag). Rechte (both suit+rank) = highest. Linke (other 3 of Schlag rank) are also top trumps. Criticals: Maxi (K♥), Belli (7♦), Spitz (7♣). NO obligation to follow suit. Secret partner signaling ALLOWED.

history.origins: Watten is a sociable card game widely played across the Alps from Bavaria through the Austrian Tyrol to South Tyrol. Tradition holds it emerged in its present form in the Kingdom of Bavaria during the Napoleonic Wars, when allied French and Bavarian troops played in encampments; the name may come from French "va tout" (last trump) or from South Tyrolean Italian/Ladinian battere/báte (beating). It remains one of the most popular games in the Alpine region.
timeline: Early 19th century: Game emerged in present form in Bavaria during Napoleonic Wars era.
1881: Watten tournament in Niederdorf, South Tyrol.
history.evolution: One of the most popular games in Alpine region.

setup.players: Four players in two fixed partnerships, partners sitting opposite; also playable by two or three.
setup.deck: 32 German cards: Acorns, Leaves, Hearts, Bells. A-K-O-U-10-9-8-7.

rules.objective: Win at least three of the five tricks in each hand to score points; the first team to reach 11 (or 15) cumulative points wins the game.
rules.gameplay: Choose Schlag (trump rank) and trump suit. Rechte (Schlag+suit) = top. Linke (other 3 Schlag) = next. Criticals: Maxi(K♥), Belli(7♦), Spitz(7♣) = permanent top trumps. NO suit obligation. Signaling between partners ALLOWED. Raising stakes possible (fold or accept).
